name: Coldridge Valley 'A Small Mistake': only the Damaged Security Bot holds the clue, and its corpse completes the quest (#5913)
contract: Report #5913: killing the security bot by the Frostmane troll cave did not complete 'A Small Mistake' (quest 254000), and the quest had no map marker.
quest_template 254000 requires item 254000, Security Bot AN-29, and nothing else; Efry Cogspark (254000) starts and ends it.
creature_loot_template 254004 (Damaged Security Bot, spawned at -6340.81, 802.589 beside the northern troll cave) pays item 254000 at 100% to a player on the quest.

creature_loot_template 254005 (Security Bot AN-32, spawned at -6416.3, 452.161 beside the western troll cave, where the report was filed) pays item 254001, the clue of the follow-up quest 254001 'We Found Her!', which needs this quest first.

So the bot beside the reporter belongs to the next quest and gives nothing for 254000, while the Damaged Security Bot completes it; quest_poi_points for 254000 point at -6341, 803 and the quest ends with Efry Cogspark.
